description:
Daily OHLCV (open, high, low, close, volume) history for one crypto asset over the requested lookback (1-3650 days). Use it when the user asks for price history, chart data, or wants to reason about past price movement rather than the current spot. Supply quote_token and market_data_venue together to select an exact market, or provider for an external source; omit these overrides to select a Mangrove market.

[Access: pay 0.01 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

lookback_days.description: Number of days of history to request.

market_data_venue.description: Exact venue of the requested market.

provider.description: Optional upstream override; omitted uses the existing server default.

quote_token.description: Quote currency of the requested market.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_ohlcv
